steps.npc: Ignisia claims it's some kind of evil spirit.
Nah, I believe in things I can stab and kill. This is all just a storm in a teacup. I mean, how can wind and snow be evil? My toad is more of a threat!
Yeah, just a bit of fun. I have a pet - he's around here somewhere, assuming that troublesome cat hasn't eaten him.

steps.player: That's a bit weird, but okay.

steps.npc: No weirder than being scared of snow.
I'm Captain Kalt, proud member of the Shayzien Army.

steps.player: How long have you been a soldier?

steps.npc: Man and boy I've worn the uniform. Earned Captain a few years back and never looked back. Not too happy about babysitting delusional wizards though. But orders is orders.

steps.npc: Go play in the snow and come back when you've done something.
